cues.show: You with the guitar, the drill's tab on screen with the pick strokes under it.
cues.say: This drill is for the hand that holds the pick. The same strokes repeat across the strings.

cues.show: Picking hand close up: the grip, then one down stroke and one up stroke.
cues.say: Hold the pick between your thumb and the side of your first finger, with only the tip showing.

cues.show: Picking hand close up: the grip, then one down stroke and one up stroke.
cues.say: A down stroke goes towards the floor. An up stroke comes back. The movement is small and comes from the wrist.

cues.show: Point at the stroke marks under the tab. Press Pick if the finger numbers are showing.
cues.say: Under the tab are the strokes to use for each note. If you see finger numbers there, press Pick to see the strokes.

cues.show: Press the Play button and play along across the strings.
cues.say: Press the Play button below to start the metronome and the notes, one note on each beat.

cues.show: Press the Play button and play along across the strings.
cues.say: When the tab moves to the next string, your hand moves with it and the strokes carry on in the same order.

cues.show: Play a few notes with a weak up stroke, then even them out.
cues.say: Listen for the up strokes. They are often quieter than the down strokes.

cues.show: Play a few notes with a weak up stroke, then even them out.
cues.say: Practice until the up stroke is as loud as the down stroke.

cues.show: Press Click to mute the metronome and play alone. Then play it on open strings only.
cues.say: Try things with it. Take your other hand off the neck and play the strokes on the open strings, so you only think about the pick.

cues.show: Press Click to mute the metronome and play alone. Then play it on open strings only.
cues.say: Play it very quietly, then loudly, with the same small movement.

cues.show: Press Click to mute the metronome and play alone. Then play it on open strings only.
cues.say: Press Click below to mute the metronome and keep the beat by yourself.
